context: Private formative challenge for mixed software developers, followed by separate named-role validation. Candidate task-local semantics only.
goal: Prepare the current candidate meanings for the engineer-assessment research product and MVP software.

payload.applicability: Candidate assessment and MVP design only; semantic owner review required before operational use.

boundaries: The ASR output is not the source Response.
A successful job does not imply words or reasoning evidence were transcribed correctly.
working_meaning.ownership_posture: Task-local proposed meaning; semantic owner principal unassigned.
working_meaning.scope: One transcription job and source media version.
working_meaning.statement: An ASR Run is a version-pinned speech-to-text processing attempt on one Media Object, retaining engine/configuration, status, uncertainty and output Transcript reference or failure.

payload.applicability: Candidate assessment and MVP design only; semantic owner review required before operational use.

boundaries: Correction never rewrites the original Media Object.
Corrected text cannot be treated as an independently recorded spoken answer.
working_meaning.ownership_posture: Task-local proposed meaning; semantic owner principal unassigned.
working_meaning.scope: One transcript successor version.
working_meaning.statement: A Transcript Correction is an attributable, versioned change proposed or confirmed by a participant or authorized reviewer against one Transcript, preserving the prior text, source alignment and reason.

payload.applicability: Candidate assessment and MVP design only; semantic owner review required before operational use.

boundaries: A span is supporting material, not a rating or proof of construct validity.
A text excerpt must remain traceable to the source and its transcription uncertainty.
working_meaning.ownership_posture: Task-local proposed meaning; semantic owner principal unassigned.
working_meaning.scope: One rating claim about one answer version.
working_meaning.statement: An Answer Evidence Span is a source-linked excerpt or time interval in one Response or Transcript cited for a specific Criterion Rating, with version, location and correction status.

payload.applicability: Candidate assessment and MVP design only; semantic owner review required before operational use.

boundaries: Adjudication does not erase rater disagreement.
A resolved rating is not ground truth about future work performance.
working_meaning.ownership_posture: Task-local proposed meaning; semantic owner principal unassigned.
working_meaning.scope: One discrepancy within a Scoring Run or calibration exercise.
working_meaning.statement: An Adjudication is a separately attributable resolution of a declared rating disagreement under a pinned rule, preserving all independent ratings, cited evidence and resolution reason.

payload.applicability: Candidate assessment and MVP design only; semantic owner review required before operational use.

boundaries: A pseudonym is not proof that reidentification is impossible.
An export receipt does not grant a new purpose or override withdrawal.
working_meaning.ownership_posture: Task-local proposed meaning; semantic owner principal unassigned.
working_meaning.scope: One approved research extract and delivery.
working_meaning.statement: A Research Export is a purpose-filtered, pseudonymized and versioned dataset delivery with exact protocol, eligibility snapshot, field set, source lineage, recipient, expiry and revocation record.

payload.applicability: Candidate assessment and MVP design only; semantic owner review required before operational use.

boundaries: A request is not proof that deletion or correction has completed.
A documented exception must not be hidden as a successful deletion.
working_meaning.ownership_posture: Task-local proposed meaning; semantic owner principal unassigned.
working_meaning.scope: One participant request under the selected privacy protocol.
working_meaning.statement: A Participant Rights Request is an attributable request for access, correction, research withdrawal or deletion, with verification, affected-record lineage, applicable decision, execution state and response receipt.

payload.applicability: Candidate assessment and MVP design only; semantic owner review required before operational use.

boundaries: Software defaults cannot select a lawful retention duration.
A schedule is not evidence that deletion ran successfully.
working_meaning.ownership_posture: Task-local proposed meaning; semantic owner principal unassigned.
working_meaning.scope: One Challenge deployment and its data classes.
working_meaning.statement: A Retention Schedule is an owner-reviewed, versioned mapping from data class and purpose to trigger, expiry, deletion route and documented exception under the selected jurisdiction.

payload.applicability: Candidate assessment and MVP design only; semantic owner review required before operational use.

boundaries: An audit event does not itself authorize access.
A log of a requested action is not proof that its downstream work completed.
working_meaning.ownership_posture: Task-local proposed meaning; semantic owner principal unassigned.
working_meaning.scope: One protected read, write, export or deletion action.
working_meaning.statement: An Access Audit Event is an append-only record of a staff or service action on a protected resource, with actor, purpose, target, time, outcome and causal job reference while excluding answer text and secrets.

payload.applicability: Candidate assessment and MVP design only; semantic owner review required before operational use.

boundaries: A pseudonym does not make answer data anonymous.
A participant identity does not imply research inclusion or an employment candidate identity.
working_meaning.ownership_posture: Task-local proposed meaning; semantic owner principal unassigned.
working_meaning.scope: One person within a Challenge deployment.
working_meaning.statement: A Challenge Participant is one pseudonymous person identity eligible to enter a declared Challenge, linked to contact and reidentification data only through restricted custody.

payload.applicability: Candidate assessment and MVP design only; semantic owner review required before operational use.

boundaries: A vault is not a research extract or scorer input.
Storing a key separately does not alone prevent reidentification.
working_meaning.ownership_posture: Task-local proposed meaning; semantic owner principal unassigned.
working_meaning.scope: One challenge deployment and its authorized identity operations.
working_meaning.statement: An Identity Vault is the restricted mapping between a Challenge Participant's pseudonym and contact or reidentification data, with separate access, retention and deletion controls.

payload.applicability: Candidate assessment and MVP design only; semantic owner review required before operational use.

boundaries: A notice is not proof that it was displayed or understood.
Changing material wording creates a new version and cannot silently revise earlier Purpose Choices.
working_meaning.ownership_posture: Task-local proposed meaning; semantic owner principal unassigned.
working_meaning.scope: One challenge release and displayed locale.
working_meaning.statement: A Participant Notice Version is immutable participant-facing wording for one locale and effective period that names processing purposes, controller/contact, recipients, retention references and rights routes by content digest.

payload.applicability: Candidate assessment and MVP design only; semantic owner review required before operational use.

boundaries: Queued intent is not completed effect.
Retrying must not duplicate a committed export, deletion or notification.
working_meaning.ownership_posture: Task-local proposed meaning; semantic owner principal unassigned.
working_meaning.scope: One media, transcription, export, rights or notification operation.
working_meaning.statement: An Outbox Job is a durable, idempotent intent to perform one asynchronous operation on pinned records, with status, retries, causal action and completion or failure receipt.

payload.applicability: Candidate assessment and MVP design only; semantic owner review required before operational use.

boundaries: A brief is not a generated case or a release decision.
A difficulty target is a hypothesis until tested with people.
working_meaning.ownership_posture: Task-local proposed meaning; semantic owner principal unassigned.
working_meaning.scope: One case-generation batch for a formative or role-linked study.
working_meaning.statement: A Case Generation Brief is a frozen request for one case-development batch stating session purpose, intended construct, audience, reasoning mechanism target, case grammar, constraints, response modes, language, time budget, forbidden patterns, exposure exclusions and review criteria.

payload.applicability: Candidate assessment and MVP design only; semantic owner review required before operational use.

boundaries: Reproducible inputs do not guarantee identical stochastic output.
A run cannot approve or publish its own candidates.
working_meaning.ownership_posture: Task-local proposed meaning; semantic owner principal unassigned.
working_meaning.scope: One candidate-producing execution; no live administration.
working_meaning.statement: A Case Generation Run is one reproducible execution of a pinned Case Generator against one Generation Brief, retaining model or human author, prompt/configuration, seed where applicable, inputs, all outputs, cost and failure receipts.

payload.applicability: Candidate assessment and MVP design only; semantic owner review required before operational use.

boundaries: A draft is never assignable to a scored participant.
Changing a candidate creates a successor rather than hiding the rejected version.
working_meaning.ownership_posture: Task-local proposed meaning; semantic owner principal unassigned.
working_meaning.scope: One pre-release draft and revision lineage.
working_meaning.statement: A Case Candidate is an immutable draft prompt, reveal plan and proposed answer/rubric blueprint from a Generation Run or named human author, linked to its brief, mechanism and development status before release.

payload.applicability: Candidate assessment and MVP design only; semantic owner review required before operational use.

boundaries: A shared topic is not necessarily a shared solution mechanism.
An embedding or model label alone cannot certify distinct reasoning mechanisms.
working_meaning.ownership_posture: Task-local proposed meaning; semantic owner principal unassigned.
working_meaning.scope: One candidate or family comparison in the Item Bank.
working_meaning.statement: A Reasoning Mechanism Fingerprint is a reviewer-visible description of the inference, assumption change, causal model, tradeoff or strategic move needed to solve a Case Candidate, separate from its wording and theme.

payload.applicability: Candidate assessment and MVP design only; semantic owner review required before operational use.

boundaries: A low similarity score is not proof of novelty or security.
Similarity thresholds and search corpus must be pinned; unseen public items remain possible.
working_meaning.ownership_posture: Task-local proposed meaning; semantic owner principal unassigned.
working_meaning.scope: One candidate screening pass against a dated comparison corpus.
working_meaning.statement: A Case Similarity Assessment is a versioned comparison of a Case Candidate with selected bank and known-public items on surface wording, scenario structure, underlying mechanism, answer leakage and exposure evidence, recording method, thresholds and reviewer resolution.

payload.applicability: Candidate assessment and MVP design only; semantic owner review required before operational use.

boundaries: A trial response does not establish role validity or calibrated difficulty.
Trial exposure changes later reuse and must be tracked.
working_meaning.ownership_posture: Task-local proposed meaning; semantic owner principal unassigned.
working_meaning.scope: One draft and a declared volunteer sample.
working_meaning.statement: A Case Trial is a consented, non-scored development administration of a Case Candidate under a pinned protocol, capturing time, comprehension, solution paths, accessibility issues and prior exposure for case evaluation.

payload.applicability: Candidate assessment and MVP design only; semantic owner review required before operational use.

boundaries: Reviewer agreement is not proof of predictive validity.
A generator cannot be the sole reviewer of its own output.
working_meaning.ownership_posture: Task-local proposed meaning; semantic owner principal unassigned.
working_meaning.scope: One candidate and intended use before release or revision.
working_meaning.statement: A Case Review is an independent, attributable assessment of a Case Candidate and its Case Evaluation against declared answerability, alternate answers, construct evidence, access, time, cultural/context dependence, similarity and exposure criteria, with unresolved objections preserved.

payload.applicability: Candidate assessment and MVP design only; semantic owner review required before operational use.

boundaries: A disposition does not admit a definition or authorize participant data collection.
Retirement stops new assignment but does not rewrite historical responses or research evidence.
working_meaning.ownership_posture: Task-local proposed meaning; semantic owner principal unassigned.
working_meaning.scope: One candidate or released Case Version and use context.
working_meaning.statement: A Case Disposition is an attributable decision under an assigned case-bank role to reject, revise, hold, release or retire an exact case version for a named use, citing reviews, exposure, rubric compatibility and effective time.

payload.applicability: Candidate assessment and MVP design only; semantic owner review required before operational use.

boundaries: A documented rule does not execute itself or grant authority.
A research hypothesis about question quality is not an enforced rule until an owner selects a check and response.
working_meaning.ownership_posture: Task-local proposed meaning; semantic owner principal unassigned.
working_meaning.scope: One case-bank process and declared version.
working_meaning.statement: A Question Lifecycle Rule is a versioned, scoped constraint on case development, review, release, assignment or retirement with an identified owner, check, failure handling and affected records.

payload.applicability: Candidate assessment and MVP design only; semantic owner review required before operational use.

boundaries: A use case is not an API operation or authorization.
Completion criteria do not establish that an experiment succeeded.
working_meaning.ownership_posture: Task-local proposed meaning; semantic owner principal unassigned.
working_meaning.scope: One actor goal within question development or operation.
working_meaning.statement: A Question Lifecycle Use Case is an actor's bounded objective in the case bank, identifying trigger, permitted inputs, expected outcome and completion evidence without prescribing every implementation step.

payload.applicability: Candidate assessment and MVP design only; semantic owner review required before operational use.

boundaries: An operation's success receipt is not scientific validation of the case.
An operation cannot grant owner authority absent an exact prior decision.
working_meaning.ownership_posture: Task-local proposed meaning; semantic owner principal unassigned.
working_meaning.scope: One bounded executable step in the question lifecycle.
working_meaning.statement: A Question Lifecycle Operation is one idempotent or explicitly non-repeatable action with defined actor, input preconditions, state transition, output records and refusal or retry behavior in the case bank.

payload.applicability: Candidate assessment and MVP design only; semantic owner review required before operational use.

boundaries: A workflow definition is not a run or evidence that all gates passed.
A review checkpoint does not itself authorize a release decision.
working_meaning.ownership_posture: Task-local proposed meaning; semantic owner principal unassigned.
working_meaning.scope: One declared question-development route and intended use.
working_meaning.statement: A Question Lifecycle Workflow is a versioned ordering of case-bank operations, rule checks, review gates and branches from generation brief through draft, release, monitoring and retirement, preserving provenance at every transition.

originating_intent: Define every critical assessment and MVP software concept before implementation and participant collection.
